values.meaning: cooldown reduction per Lightslinger shot hit (per non-champion target)
values.quote: reduced by 1 second for each ''{{ai|Lightslinger|Lucian}}'' shot hit

values.meaning: cooldown reduction per Lightslinger shot hit on an enemy champion

mechanics.claim: Relentless Pursuit resets Lucian's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: Relentless Pursuit {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Lucian's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Lucian can cast any of his abilities during the dash, including casting E during W's cast time or R's channel.
mechanics.quote: '''Lucian''' can cast any of his [[champion ability|abilities]] during the dash. Relentless Pursuit can be cast during {{ais|W|Lucian}} cast time and during {{ais|R|Lucian}} channel.

mechanics.claim: Additional on-hits during Lightslinger (e.g. Runaan's Hurricane, Guinsoo's Rageblade) do not count toward the cooldown reduction.
mechanics.quote: Additional on-hits during ''Lightslinger'' are not considered for the cooldown reduction (i.e {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}, {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}).

mechanics.claim: Casting Relentless Pursuit directly after a Lightslinger attack will still reduce its cooldown once the projectiles hit.
mechanics.quote: Casting ''Relentless Pursuit'' directly after attacking with ''Lightslinger'' will reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown when the projectiles hit the target.
